title: BUDGET AND FINANCE and ENERGY AND ENVIRONMENT COMMITTEES' REPORT relative to a grant application for the United States Department of Interior, Bureau of…
text:
[Council File 21-1015-S20]
[Items for which Public Hearings Have Not Been Held - (10 Votes Required for Consideration)]
BUDGET AND FINANCE and ENERGY AND ENVIRONMENT COMMITTEES' REPORT relative to a grant application for the United States Department of Interior, Bureau of Reclamation, WaterSMART Drought Response Program Grant for Fiscal Year (FY) 2026.
Recommendation for Council action:
1. AUTHORIZE the Director, Bureau of Sanitation (BOS), or designees, to prepare and submit a grant application for the United States Department of Interior, Bureau of Reclamation, WaterSMART Drought Response Program Grant – FY 2026 proposal.
2. INSTRUCT the Director, BOS, or designees, to report to Council if the City is awarded the grants, to request authority to accept the grant awards; and, to request approval for any related actions to implement the grant awards.
Fiscal Impact Statement:
The CAO reports that approval of the recommendations in the report will not result in a General Fund impact. There is a 50 percent matching funds requirement for the DRP grant. However, upon notification of a grant award, a reassessment on the General Fund impact should be completed as it relates to either lower than requested grant award amounts, verification of local match requirements, or front- funding for grants on a reimbursement basis. Financial policies The CAO reports that the recommendations in the report comply with the City’s statement Financial Policies.
Community Impact Statement:
None submitted
summary: The City Administrative Officer reports on a grant application to the federal Bureau of Reclamation's WaterSMART Drought Response Program for fiscal year 2026.
